claim: The paper's headline production rate (12/17 = 70.6%) is cited in the text but not backed by any committed trace artifact. The controlled split (n=15) is fully backed and reproduces the same structure with per-condition detail. Additionally, ground-truth availability is asymmetric: seed bench records expected values, test bench does not.

h007_corroboration.finding: Rule 9 shifts placeholder notation from brace-form to prose deferral (12/12 format-condition outputs). Both forms are caught by TEMPLATE_RE. The recorder's narrow classifier would label prose as wrong_value; only TEMPLATE_RE catches it.
h007_corroboration.implication: The recorder's classifier undercounts failures whose surface form is prose, not brace. The verifier does not undercount. This is the same pattern as the $sN bug but affects the format condition instead of the baseline condition.
